responsibility: Integrates Chalk-based trait solving into `rustc_traits` by connecting rustc’s query layer, type representations, and Chalk’s IR/database interfaces. `mod.rs` drives end-to-end goal evaluation by turning canonical rustc trait obligations into solver requests and rebuilding rustc query results from Chalk answers; `lowering.rs` provides the bidirectional conversion between rustc types, predicates, goals, substitutions, and binders and their Chalk IR forms; and `db.rs` supplies the `RustIrDatabase` and unification support that expose `TyCtxt` facts about items, signatures, predicates, and variances to the solver. Together, these files let rustc express its trait problems in Chalk, supply the semantic data Chalk needs, and translate solutions back into rustc’s canonical query model.
